title: Mendel's Peas
tagline: A monk, 28,000 pea plants, and a 3-to-1 ratio nobody noticed for 34 years.
description: In a monastery garden, Gregor Mendel counted peas for seven years and discovered the rules of heredity. Build a Punnett square, grow a hundred plants yourself, and see the 3:1 ratio appear.
coverAlt: A cartoon pea pod with three round peas and one wrinkled pea peeking out
